units: return_* and *_pct are percent points (5.0 = 5%); *_fraction is 0 to 1; *_minutes is wall-clock; *_bars is actual observed bars
change_policy: any edit changes the canonical checksum and makes this a different study; post-result changes go to b_fsm_rules_v2.json with a new declaration
config_binding: every numeric threshold here equals the StrategyBConfig default of the same path; a test asserts the two are identical

universe_exclusions: CON: a DOS device name, which no Windows-backed store can hold as a directory

spread_gate.reason: Basic minute bars carry no quotes and no spread is estimated

score.momentum_ratio: max over available legs of return_leg / leg_threshold

eligibility.scope: scope.evaluate_research_scope eligible, D-1 metadata and daily bars only
eligibility.recheck: every tick in every non-terminal state, ahead of the TTL check

fsm.tick: one minute bar availability time (bar_start + 1 minute)
fsm.qualified_and_watching: stamped on the same tick; counted as one transition
fsm.only_backward_transition: SETUP_READY -> WATCHING when the setup is gone but not broken

HOD_BREAKOUT.hod_index_rule: earliest bar reaching the running high
HOD_BREAKOUT.consolidation_window: bars after the HOD bar up to the last available bar
HOD_BREAKOUT.invalidation: last actual bar closes below initial_stop -> CANCELLED
HOD_BREAKOUT.rearm: re-detected every tick: no valid setup -> back to WATCHING; a different trigger_price or initial_stop -> the setup is replaced and its TTL restarts

FIRST_PULLBACK.reason: one setup at a time; defined in config but not detected, not backtested in V1

entry.signal: first actual bar with high >= trigger_price, judged at bar availability time

fill_model.primary: signal bar: trigger_price when open <= trigger_price <= high, open when open > trigger_price
fill_model.sensitivity: B-E0 also computes a conservative next-bar-open variant

sizing.cap_direction: max_position_pct only lowers the risk-based share count, never raises it

entry.costs: fees and slippage numbers are declared in B-E0, not here
entry.signal_then_fill: the engine answers on a later tick, so entered_at is the tick the fill was recorded and the fill price refers to the signal bar
entry.trigger_lookback: every bar that became available since the setup armed

exit.hard_stop: actual bar low <= stop; fill at stop, or at open when the bar gaps below
exit.after_partial: remaining stop moves to entry price (breakeven)
exit.time_stop_condition: partial take profit not reached within 30 wall-clock minutes of entry
exit.scan_starts_at: the entry bar itself, so a bar that fills and then breaks the stop is a taken loss
exit.stop_reason_rule: HARD_STOP while the stop is still the initial stop, TRAILING_STOP once it has moved
exit.trailing_update: before judging bar i: stop = max(stop, low of bar i-1); a stop never moves down
exit.partial_rounding: floor(shares * partial_exit_fraction); 0 means the whole position exits at the target
exit.deadline_fill: close of the last actual bar before the deadline; a bar printed after it is not used
exit.catch_up: several bars in one call are judged bar by bar, identical to tick-by-tick calls
exit.eod_clamp: min(eod_exit_et, regular_close - eod_min_margin_minutes): an early close still exits before the bell

pit.hod: running extreme up to as_of, never the final high of the day

determinism.symbol_order: score desc, rolling_dollar_volume desc, symbol asc
